title: Matrix-Free Stabilized BDF Schemes for Semilinear Parabolic Equations with Unconditional Maximum Bound Principle Preservation and Energy Stability
summary: We develop a family of stabilized backward differentiation formula (sBDF) schemes of orders one through four for semilinear parabolic equations. The proposed methods are designed to achieve three properties that are rarely available simultaneously in high-order time discretizations: unconditional preservation of the maximum bound principle (MBP), unconditional discrete energy stability, and practical matrix-free implementation.
